network.name: Hardhat in-process network
network.note: Transactions were sent to a temporary test chain, so the hashes exist only inside this benchmark run.

steps.step: Owner creates the 1,000 tokens one transaction at a time
Owner allows the marketplace to move the tokens
Owner publishes a listing for 600 tokens
Investor 1 allows the marketplace to move their tokens
A new investor approves the payment
A new investor buys 30 tokens from Investor 1
Buyer sends the price to the platform
Owner creates all 1,000 tokens in one transaction
Owner allows the marketplace to move the tokens
Owner signs one sell order for 600 tokens
Investor 1 allows the marketplace to move their tokens
A new investor buys 30 tokens from Investor 1
Buyer allows the sale contract to hold the price
Buyer offers for the whole property and the price is held
Platform confirms the legal transfer and publishes the payouts
